record.title: Ambassador Bridge protest blockade of Canada-bound traffic
record.direction: Canada-bound interval; US-bound access restored by February 8.
record.movement: Canada-bound passenger and commercial traffic through Ambassador Bridge; initial disruption also affected US-bound traffic.
record.exceptions: US-bound commercial traffic could use surface-street access from February 8; emergency access and diversion via other crossings existed.
record.enforcement: Policy or report as cited; uniform implementation at every crossing not presumed.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.official_rationale: Protest opposition to pandemic restrictions; CBSA suspended unsafe or inaccessible service.
record.context: Non-state blockade, distinct from government public-health border order.
record.uncertainty: CBSA service-resumption message 00:11 ET February 14 defines endpoint for Canada-bound processing. US-bound access was restored by February 8, so the interval must not be read as continuous bidirectional closure. RCMP NATTERJACK instead places full bridge reopening late on February13; physical reopening versus CBSA message timing remains unresolved.

historical.duration_note: No exact interval: RCMP places reopening late February13 while CBSA service-resumption message is February14 00:11 ET.
